newsitem.title: USA: HORSE RACING-UNBRIDLED'S SONG RETIRED DUE TO INJURY.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-UNBRIDLED'S SONG RETIRED DUE TO INJURY.

text.p: Unbridled's Song, the 1996 Florida Derby winner who went down to defeat as the favourite in the Kentucky Derby, suffered a broken cannon bone in his right front leg Friday and was retired.
Trainer Nick Zito announced that the four-year-old colt broke his leg during a morning gallop at Gulfstream Park in Florida under regular rider Mike Smith.
"He seemed slightly off this week, but X-rays at first did not disclose anything," Zito said. "Today, though, Mike brought him back after a gallop and he seemed off in his right fore."
Owner Ernie Paragallo made the decision to retire the horse to Taylor Made Farm outside Lexington, Kentucky.
Unbridled's Song, the son of 1990 Kentucky Derby winner Unbridled, won the 1995 Breeder's Cup Juvenille and the 1996 Florida Derby, which reinforced his position as Kentucky Derby favourite.
Unbridled's Song was forced to wear cumbersome bar shoes at Churchill Downs due to a hoof injury and finished fifth.
